node: HVDC reactors, high-voltage power equipment, and grid power-quality components
summary: Layer 1B expanded the US-listed universe for HVDC, high-voltage grid equipment, transmission hardware, and power-quality components. The two-lane funnel keeps GE Vernova as the obvious HVDC/grid reference anchor, while the underfollowed lane surfaces Hubbell, Preformed Line Products, and American Superconductor as more component-level or power-quality exposures that may benefit from transmission buildout, renewable integration, data-center interconnection, and grid reliability spending. Evidence strength is highest for GE Vernova and Hubbell, moderate for PLPC, and more hypothesis-driven for AMSC because its relevance depends on whether utility and renewable interconnection demand increasingly converts into orders for D-VAR/reactive power and grid-resiliency systems.
